SELECT FROM crm_dify_knowledge_config c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_dify_knowledge_config c SET c.provider=#{e.provider},c.base_url=#{e.baseUrl},c.app_api_key_cipher=#{e.appApiKeyCipher},c.dataset_id=#{e.datasetId},c.dataset_api_key_cipher=#{e.datasetApiKeyCipher},c.sync_enabled=#{e.syncEnabled},c.timeout_seconds=#{e.timeoutSeconds},c.enabled=#{e.enabled},c.connection_status='UNVERIFIED',c.last_error_masked=NULL,c.last_connected_at=NULL,c.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),c.version=c.version+1 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id=#{id} AND c.version=#{version}
